linkedin:
Call `mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI, { maxPoolSize: 10, serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 5000 })` once at startup, never inside a route.

Read the connection string from a `MONGODB_URI` environment variable, not from code. Attach `connection.on('error')` and `'connected'` handlers so failures are loud. Turn `autoIndex` off in production and build indexes on purpose.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/connect-mongoose-to-mongodb/

Call `mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI, { maxPoolSize: 10, serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 5000 })` once at startup, never inside a route.
Read the connection string from a `MONGODB_URI` environment variable, not from code.
Attach `connection.on('error')` and `'connected'` handlers so failures are loud.
